scenarios.given: One settler on hull A; four attack escorts on idle hull B at same port; spare capacity and optional claimant for A.
scenarios.expect: One escort transfers to A; party groups; surplus claim clears; A sails to a committed reachable site.

scenarios.given: Escort exhausts movement while loading; ship can sail.
scenarios.expect: Sail now; wait at coast until all cargo can move; land settler and escort together.

scenarios.given: Same coastal site: 12 turns walking, two sailing plus transfers.
scenarios.expect: Ferry wins; area identity alone cannot unload the settler.

scenarios.given: Escort-only civilian head hull with loaded settler follower.
scenarios.expect: Follower separates, retains destination and runs civilian dispatch independently.

scenarios.given: Turn-zero city has actionable water improvement, trainable workboat, no guards or local enemy attack.
Permute settler, donor hull, recipient hull and escort updates at port.
scenarios.expect: No duplicate claims, lost parties, repeated unload/reload loop or unreasoned idle turn.

scenarios.given: Host border, enemy, terrain or settlement changes after commitment; save/reload in transit.
scenarios.expect: Mission persistence and replanning agree with engine trace; no illegal landing.

scenarios.given: Required escort never arrives; no alternate assignment.
scenarios.expect: Measure and eliminate unbounded legacy pickup retries with a persistent lease/cooldown policy.

scenarios.given: Several idle galleys, feasible civilian jobs and pending production.
scenarios.expect: Assign compatible idle capacity before ordering additional hulls; demand tied to jobs.
